"By accepting the Terms of Service and using our product, we may collect non-personally identifiable information such as installed applications/packages and primary account. A detailed set of the information we access and collect is as follows:
①Installed Applications/Packages. When you use Aplikasi Paralel, we collect your installed applications/packages information to provide you with a customized list of recommended apps that can be cloned and relevant compatibility notes. But this information is only stored in memory and will never be uploaded to our server or shared with any third parties.
②Primary Account. When you log in to your primary account in our app, we will collect your main account information to our server. We do not share your primary account information with any third party. Such information is collected, uploaded, and used for the sole purpose of confirming your that your VIP information is accurate and granting the premium feature to you.
③Crash Logs. We track and retain logs regarding crashes users experience while using the Aplikasi Paralel. These logs contain information about the error types, timestamp that the error occurred, and general device information listed above. Crash information is necessary for us to better understand issues users are encountering during standard use of our service, and allows us to address technical problems more effectively. No personal information is stored in crash logs."
